label: Conic sections intro
subgoals: Recognize the circle as a conic section

visual.title: The centre and radius sit in the standard form
visual.caption: A circle written as (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r² has centre (h, k) and radius r. Here (x − 1)² + (y + 2)² = 4, so the centre is (1, −2) and the radius is 2. The expanded equation in the figure has the same centre and radius.

predict.question: For (x − 1)² + (y + 2)² = 4, what are the centre and radius?
predict.explain: The signs inside the squares flip when you read the centre: h = 1 and k = −2. The right side is r² = 4, so r = 2, not 4.
